name: AzukiDAO BEAN repeated airdrop claims
summary: Bean.claim sets signatureClaimed and tokenClaimed but never checks them before paying. NFT holders replay valid signed claims and repeatedly transfer BEAN from the preminted airdrop reserve to themselves, then sell it for ETH.
notes: The Bean runtime never checks signatureClaimed or tokenClaimed, so deployment sets the age. The anchor is the first reuse of an already-claimed signature; first authorized claims (e.g. 0x7fef7c0d) are not exploits.

Campaign: every successful direct claim() whose signature bytes had already been used (Etherscan txlist of Bean, deduplicated by signature): 730 more by the attacker 0x85d231 and 8 by 0x8eadc7. No replay after block 17593313.
BEAN is valued at each actor's realised ETH from its BEAN sales (the attacker's sales crashed the pair), pro rata to replayed versus first-claim BEAN.
